blocks.text: Christmas time means pop-up bazaars everywhere, chat and Facebook groups blowing up with stuff for sale, e-commerce platforms offering vouchers, and everyone rushing to mall sales and special offers. As a young and impressionable working adult, there’s no shortage of things and experiences you can spend your hard-earned Christmas bonus on. While you deserve to reward yourself and your loved ones this holiday season, choosing not just what you spend on but how you pay for it can make a difference in making the most of your bonus pay.
